info.title: UBLost&Found API Documentation
info.description:
# Universitas Bakrie Lost and Found System 

Official REST API documentation for the **UBLost&Found** system. UBLost&Found connects students and university staff (Admin BEM) to facilitate reporting, securing, claiming, and returning lost and found items.

### Key Concepts & Workflows
- **Authentication & Roles:**
  - **Student (`role: user`):** Can report lost or found items, submit claims for secured found items, view personal history, and generate temporary QR tokens for scheduled claims.
  - **Admin BEM (`role: Admin_BEM`):** Can directly log secured items, review student reports, approve/reject claims, scan QR tokens during handover, review MongoDB audit logs, and generate PDF reports.
- **Report moderation and physical lifecycle are separate:** Student reports start with `report_review_status: pending` and are hidden from the public catalog until accepted. Admin approval changes only the review status; it does not secure the physical item. Found reports must separately transition through physical `status: pending` to `secured` before they can be claimed. Rejected reports have `report_review_status: rejected` and are excluded from public endpoints; `rejected` is not an item lifecycle status.
- **Catalog & Item Privacy:** Accepted lost and found reports share the catalog; claims are limited to accepted, secured found items. Items categorized as sensitive (e.g. *Elektronik*, *Dompet/Identitas*) are automatically blurred using Sharp during upload. Admins can toggle sensitivity during securing.
- **QR Handover Protocol:** Scheduled claims generate a temporary QR token valid for up to 30 minutes. The physical item handover is confirmed atomically when Admin BEM scans the QR token at the security desk.
- **Auto-Donation:** Items remaining unclaimed for over 90 days are transitioned to `donated` status via background scheduled jobs.

BearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token obtained from `/api/auth/login` (Student) or `/api/auth/admin/login` (Admin BEM). Format: `Bearer <token>`

nim.description: NIM for students or NIP for admins

token.description: Signed JWT; backend role claims remain unchanged

user.description: Same frontend user object as the top-level user property

default_sensitive.description: 1 = items in this category are automatically blurred upon upload; 0 = clear image by default

finder_nim.description: NIM of the student who found the item, or null if logged directly by admin

report_type.description: Whether this is a student lost-item report or a found-item report

report_review_status.description: Moderation status, independent from the physical item lifecycle status

manage_nip.description: NIP of security staff who verified or created the item

is_sensitive.description: 1 if item image is blurred for privacy, 0 if visible publicly

report_time.description: Optional local time associated with the report

image_path.description: Relative server path to image in static uploads folder

status.description: Physical lifecycle status: pending (not yet secured), secured (held by security), claimed (returned to owner), donated (>90 days expired). Moderation is represented separately by report_review_status.

reviewed_by.description: Admin NIP that accepted or rejected the report

category_name.example: Umum (Tumbler, Buku, Jaket, Aksesoris, Alat Tulis, dll)

message.example: Item uploaded and secured successfully by Admin

description.example: Diserahkan ke pos satpam lobby depan

challange_answer.description: Proof description provided by claimer (Note legacy database spelling: challange_answer)
challange_answer.example: Isi dompet ada KTP atas nama Thariq Rahman dan E-Money

item_id.description: ID of the item being claimed

challange_answer.description: Proof of ownership description. **REQUIRED** if item is sensitive (is_sensitive=1); optional if non-sensitive.
challange_answer.example: Dompet kulit warna cokelat tua dengan kartu KTP dan E-Money di dalamnya.

message.example: Claim submitted successfully. Please visit the security post for verification.

status.description: New status for the claim. Set to 'verified' to enable QR generation, or 'rejected'.

qr_token.description: 32-byte hexadecimal security token embedded in the user's pickup QR code

time_to_live_seconds.description: Seconds remaining before token expires (max 86400 / 24 hours)

qr_token.description: The scanned QR token string presented by student

get.description: Verifies that the UBLost&Found Express API server is alive and accepting incoming requests.

message.example: Welcome to UBLost&Found API is running...

get.description: Retrieves the raw OpenAPI 3.1 JSON specification document for client SDK generation or import into tools like Postman, Insomnia, or Swagger UI.
Serves public static item images uploaded by students or administrators, including both clear and Sharp-blurred privacy images.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Image filename as returned in `image_path` (e.g. `1767964244351-966310646.jpg` or `blur-1768034553495-212307680.jpeg`)

404.description: Image file not found on disk

post.description: Registers a new student (`general_user`) in the system. The NIM must be unique and numeric. Upon successful creation, an initial JWT token is generated.

400.description: Validation failure or NIM already registered

errors.msg: Password must be at least 6 characters

post.description: Authenticates a student by NIM or an admin by NIP and password. Returns a frontend-compatible user object and signed JWT valid for 1 hour. The JWT retains backend roles (`user`, `Admin_BEM`); the user object exposes `MAHASISWA` or `Admin_BEM`.
Authenticates an administrative user (Admin BEM) using NIP and password. Returns a signed JWT token containing administrative role (`Admin_BEM`).

get.summary: List catalog items with frontend-compatible filters
get.description: Lists active catalog reports by default: pending found and lost reports, plus secured found items. Rejected reports are excluded. Status aliases `WAITING_AT_SECURITY` and `AVAILABLE` map to pending and secured; `SCHEDULED` filters items with a scheduled claim. Rejected reports are never returned from the public list, including status=all.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Catalog lifecycle filter. Defaults to catalog; scheduled matches items with a scheduled claim.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter found_date greater than or equal to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter found_date less than or equal to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search item name, description, or location (alias: q)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by sensitivity category (alias labels: Umum/Sensitif)

post.description: Allows an authenticated student to report an item they found on campus. Requires an image file upload. If the item belongs to a sensitive category (e.g. electronics or wallets), the server automatically generates a blurred image using Sharp for privacy.

found_location.description: Location where the item was spotted

image.description: Photo proof of the item (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5MB)

400.description: Validation failed, invalid category ID, or missing image file

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Returns full details for a single item, including category name and finder's name.

404.description: Item not found or report is rejected and hidden from public access

post.description:
Submits a claim request for a lost item. 

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Spelling Notice:** The request property is spelled `challange_answer` (with an `a`), mirroring the database column.
> 
> **Sensitivity Rule:** If the item is marked as sensitive (`is_sensitive === 1`), `challange_answer` is **strictly required**. If non-sensitive, it is optional and defaults to `'- (Non-sensitive item)'`.

400.description: Duplicate claim or missing answer for sensitive item

value.message: You have already claimed this item
This is a sensitive item. You must provide a challenge answer (e.g., detail ciri-ciri).

get.description: Retrieves all claims submitted by the currently logged-in student, identified by their JWT token (`req.user.id`).
Returns all available item categories, including their default sensitivity setting (`default_sensitive: 1` triggers auto-blur). Used to populate dropdowns in the frontend.

get.summary: List all items for Admin Dashboard
get.description: Retrieves reports for the security post/admin dashboard with joined reporter and managing officer names. Filterable by physical lifecycle status, report review status, report type, search, and date range.

parameters.name: review_status
parameters.description: Filter by independent report moderation status

post.summary: Admin directly upload and secure item
post.description: Allows an admin or security officer to directly upload an item turned into the security post. The item is immediately marked with `status: secured`, assigned to the logged-in officer (`manage_nip`), auto-blurred if sensitive, and an email broadcast is dispatched asynchronously to all registered student emails.

description.example: Ditemukan di lobi kampus Plaza Festival

201.description: Item logged and secured by Admin

400.description: Missing image file or invalid category ID

403.description: Forbidden - Not authorized as an admin

put.description: Transitions a student-reported item from `pending` to `secured` status, assigning the verifying officer's NIP. Optionally toggles image sensitivity (`is_sensitive: true/false`). If sensitivity changes, the image is dynamically blurred or restored using Sharp, and an asynchronous broadcast email is dispatched to all registered users. Only pending found reports can be secured.

is_sensitive.description: Set to true to blur the image, or false to unblur the image

example.message: Item marked as secured. Sensitivity updated.

get.description: Retrieves all claims filed by students. Results are sorted prioritizing `pending` claims first, then `verified`, then `rejected`.

put.description: Updates claim status to either `verified` (approved for handover) or `rejected`. Triggers an automated decision notification email to the claimer with instructions.

400.description: Invalid status value provided (must be verified or rejected)

get.description: Queries MongoDB activity audit trails (`activity_logs` collection). Supports filtering by actor role, action name, date range, and pagination limit.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter logs starting from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter logs up to the end of this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of log entries to return

get.description: Generates and streams an official PDF summary report for Universitas Bakrie Student Affairs (Biro Kemahasiswaan). Contains statistical summaries, detailed incoming items table, returned items table, and donated items table.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Reporting period start date (defaults to 1st of current month, YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Reporting period end date (defaults to last day of current month, YYYY-MM-DD)

200.description: PDF report downloaded successfully as binary stream

500.description: Server error while rendering PDF document

get.summary: Generate QR pickup token for verified or scheduled claim
get.description: Generates or returns an existing valid 32-byte cryptographic QR token for an approved claim. The token is valid for 24 hours. The claim must belong to the logged-in student and must have status `verified` or `scheduled`.

200.description: QR token generated or retrieved successfully

400.description: Claim is not yet verified or scheduled

example.message: QR token can only be generated for verified or scheduled claims

403.description: Forbidden - Requester does not own this claim

example.message: Not authorized to view this claim

post.summary: Validate QR code & complete item handover (Admin BEM)
post.description: Scans and validates a student's QR code at the security post. In a single atomic database transaction, the item is marked as `claimed`, the claim status is updated to `claimed`, the QR token is invalidated, and an official handover receipt email is dispatched to the student.

example.message: QR Code validated and item handover successful

400.description: Token expired, item already claimed, or missing token

post.summary: Broadcast new item email to all users
post.description: Dispatches an asynchronous broadcast email announcing a newly secured item to all registered students in Universitas Bakrie. Handled in the background with HTTP 202 Accepted status.

example.message: Broadcast notification process has been started

400.description: Missing itemDetails or no registered users found

example.message: Item details with a name are required

get.summary: Get operational pickup slots or check availability by date
get.description: Retrieve recurring weekly slots and date-specific slots, or check availability and remaining quota for a target date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Target pickup date in YYYY-MM-DD format to check availability and quota

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Filter slots by day of week

200.description: Slots list or date availability returned successfully

get.description: Retrieve details of an individual pickup slot by its ID.

post.summary: Schedule pickup appointment slot for approved claim
post.description: Allows an authenticated student with an approved claim (status verified or scheduled) to book a pickup slot. Updates claim status to scheduled and triggers an email notification (FR-04).

400.description: Invalid date/slot or slot quota full

put.summary: Batch secure items (Move Pos Satpam to Glass Cabinet)
put.description: Admin BEM moves accepted found reports from Pos Satpam (pending / Menunggu di Pos Satpam) to the Glass Cabinet (secured / Tersedia di Lemari) (FR-07). Reports awaiting moderation and lost reports are skipped; an empty or omitted ID list processes all eligible reports.

item_ids.description: List of item IDs to secure. If omitted or empty, all pending items at Pos Satpam are secured.

get.summary: Get dashboard statistics for Admin BEM
get.description: Calculates real-time summary statistics for Admin BEM, including pending/rejected report moderation counts separately from physical item lifecycle counts, claim metrics, category distribution, and recent activity logs (FR-08).

pending_review_reports.description: Reports awaiting moderation; separate from physical pending items

parameters.description: Filter by actor ID (frontend actor filter; alias: actor)

delete.summary: Deactivate a pickup slot without deleting its booking history

patch.description: Changes only `report_review_status` from `pending` to `accepted`; the physical item `status` is unchanged. Only accepted found reports can later be secured and claimed.

200.description: Report accepted, with its physical lifecycle status unchanged

409.description: Only reports pending review can be accepted

patch.description: Sets `report_review_status` to `rejected` without changing the physical item lifecycle status. Rejected reports are removed from public endpoints. A report can only be rejected while pending review.

200.description: Report rejected; rejection reason, note, reviewer, and time are returned

409.description: Only pending reports can be rejected

patch.summary: Restore a rejected report to pending review
patch.description: Clears rejection metadata and sets `report_review_status` to `pending`; the physical item lifecycle status remains unchanged.

200.description: Report restored to pending review and rejection metadata cleared; physical item status unchanged

409.description: Only rejected reports can be restored
